_policy: Runs listed here stay on disk (raw data is immutable) but are left out of every analysis. Each entry needs the evidence for excluding it. Never exclude a run because its result is inconvenient.

excluded_runs.reason: Power source changed mid-run and a concurrent camera/microphone/WebRTC video call overlapped it. The run started on AC Power at 19:28 (env.json); the pmset log shows 'Using Batt' from 19:36:04 onward; camera, audio and Chrome WebRTC power assertions were active from about 19:34 to 19:42. From t=~600 s, cycles stretched from 1 s to ~2.6 s and CPU SGEMM 2048^2 degraded to 154 ms, while macOS reported thermal state nominal.
excluded_runs.evidence: pmset -g log, 2026-11-13 19:28-19:43 +0530; logs/thermal_drift.log in the session directory
excluded_runs.guard_added: thermal_drift now checks the power source every cycle and stops (exit 3, valid=no_power_changed); run_session.sh stops a session that loses AC power and records conditions.csv

excluded_runs.reason: Post-inspection decision: The system entered OS Idle Sleep at 07:30:10 (t=362 s active uptime) followed by recurring DarkWake maintenance intervals on AC Power. While the benchmark accumulated 15 minutes of processor uptime (via CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), total wall-clock time stretched to 104 minutes and 54 seconds. During DarkWake intervals, macOS applied background energy constraints that stretched CPU 2048^2 SGEMM latency by 9x (16 ms to ~180 ms) while reporting thermal state nominal. This violates the experimental requirement of continuous, uninterrupted active compute. Decided after inspecting session telemetry and pmset logs.
excluded_runs.evidence: pmset -g log showing Idle Sleep at 07:30:10; conditions.csv showing wall-clock span 07:24:09 to 09:09:03; timeseries.csv showing cycle 320 to 322 transition where latency jumped while thermal state dropped from fair to nominal.
excluded_runs.guard_added: Thermal drift runs must be protected by an active power assertion (e.g. caffeinate -dis or IOPMAssertionCreateWithName) to prevent system display sleep and idle sleep.
